description: State Ministry of Agriculture - Control of Pesticides Act No. 33 of 1980. Revoke the Order made under Section 11 of the aforesaid Act and published in Gaz. Extraordinary No. 1894/4 of 22.12.2014
categorisation: This gazette content is an order made under the Control of Pesticides Act, No. 33 of 1980, specifically revoking a previous order. It deals with regulatory matters and legal instruments, falling squarely under Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) as it involves statutory instruments and regulatory compliance requirements rather than government personnel, organizational changes, or other specialized categories.
